# what changed
- Artifacts must be `.png` / `.jpg` / `.jpeg` files whose bytes start

description tells the agent where screenshots land.
- Existing files are replaced by renaming a new file over them instead
of writing through them; filesystem errors surface as contract errors.

errors and conformance cases.

fix(integrations): save facade screenshot artifacts only as images in a dedicated directory (#3350)

# why
Screenshot artifacts returned by facade `run` code were written under
the host's working directory with whatever name and bytes the run
produced, truncating existing files in place. Hosts that set no artifact
root (stdio server, pi, eve, claude-cua) wrote straight into the project
directory.

# what changed
- Artifacts must be `.png` / `.jpg` / `.jpeg` files whose bytes start
with a PNG or JPEG signature; every artifact is checked before anything
is written, so a rejected run writes nothing.
- Default artifact root is `./stagehand-artifacts`
(`DEFAULT_ARTIFACT_DIRECTORY`); `STAGEHAND_FACADE_ARTIFACT_ROOT`
configures it for the stdio server, pi and deepagents. The run tool
description tells the agent where screenshots land.
- Existing files are replaced by renaming a new file over them instead
of writing through them; filesystem errors surface as contract errors.
- Same behaviour in the Python host; facade bundle v7 with the new
errors and conformance cases.
- stagehand-middleware 0.1.2 (npm + PyPI); eve patch changeset.

- [x] Python pytest + conformance, ruff
- [x] middleware parity, eve, pi, deepagents tests; oxfmt
- [x] built stdio server in a temp git repo: non-image and out-of-root
